special_experiences.name: Greg Capullo and Scott Snyder Comic Experience
special_experiences.price: NOT PUBLISHED - confirm with Epic Photo Ops. ~$150-250 at comparable shows.
special_experiences.note: This is the 'Snyder Fan Experience'. CONFIRMED: 3 witnessed signatures from Capullo and 3 from Snyder. Signature access is therefore a sunk cost - book selection is the only remaining lever on value. 'Witnessed' makes every book CGC Signature Series eligible.
special_experiences.constraint: The split is 3 and 3, NOT 6 Snyder. Snyder is credited on Absolute Batman and Absolute Catwoman; Capullo is credited on NO Absolute title. A dual signature consumes one slot from each signer.

cgc_signature_series.status: CONFIRMED - the Capullo & Snyder Experience signatures are witnessed, so every book signed in that session is Signature Series eligible
cgc_signature_series.why_it_matters: A CGC witness must be present at the moment of signing. It cannot be added afterward.

fees_2026.note: At $70/book, slabbing all six costs $420 - more than every comic on the list combined. Slab only where a signed 9.8 clears the ~$85-90 all-in cost. Recommendation: slab 2-3 books ($140-210), keep the rest raw.

cgc_signature_series.grade_matters: A 9.8 SS is worth a multiple of a 9.4 SS with the same signature. Buy raw copies at NM 9.6+ only. Do not pre-slab anything intended for signing.
